name: Promotion of Exportable surplus of identified spices in NE: Cultivation of NE ginger (Ha)
benefit: - 50% of cost of planting material subject to maximum of ₹ 30,000/- per Ha - Ginger growers of NE having land holding size of 0.10 Ha to 8 Ha
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a ginger grower from Sikkim, Darjeeling and Kalimpong districts of West Bengal, or other North Eastern states. 1. Eligibility is subject to final inspection and recommendation by designated officials.
